name: Jigoku no Internets
original_name: じごくのインターネッツ
source:
"The Internet sucks!"
The protagonist is a dreary writer of kotatsu articles.
He is confronted by a mysterious occult fortune teller called Naraka-chan.
Food delivery, internet memes, character contents, power spots... Is the internet heaven or...?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5227]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
“互联网，烂透了！”
主角是一名阴沉的写手，专门闭门拼凑网络文章。
一个名叫奈落酱的神秘灵异占卜师，出现在他面前。
外卖、网络迷因、角色文化、能量景点……互联网究竟是天堂，还是……？

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5227]NovelGame[/url]]
